scope: Independent optimized #12 claim/guidance/Challenge original-pixel and linked XML review at font scale2.0.

viewProtocol.order: Standard pre-entry3d-context-pane-standard-actions.png first, then every3d-context-position-00.png through-24.png in order.
viewProtocol.selection: Derived from pinned sourcePlan+phaseA+admitted amendment, including repeated/no-progress endpoints.
viewProtocol.tool: view_image with detail=original; forward each native1600x720 image unchanged.
viewProtocol.integrity: Every member checked against exact retainedFingerprint and bytes/SHA/CRC during initial read; PNG chunk CRC/IHDR validated, all26 PNG hashes/CRC/fingerprints rechecked after every external call has settled.
viewProtocol.lease: Exact direct-parent V22#12 lease remains held through all original external views. No completion acknowledgment before calls settle; actual worker-group cleanup and gate release are required.
viewProtocol.noRuntimeDecoderSubstitution: The original-resolution view tool performs actual PNG decode. No custom bitmap copies, crops or resampling.

reviewCriteria: Read complete exact round/claim/guidance words through ordered overlapping original captures.
Find a complete correctly named Challenge control in a reached usable visible area.
Compare visible scroll movement and concealed pixels against the linked observations without inferring intervening behavior.
limits: The Standard anchor is context, not proof of native text or action reachability.
Play enclosure, positive geometry and no-progress termination do not prove body bottom or native acceptance.
No Challenge gameplay action occurs in this sweep.
Sequential PNG/XML captures do not establish continuous privacy or between-capture behavior.
Raw instrumentation completion stdout is not retained; Phase A reviewed parsed completion and its hash/length.
No package, signing, physical-network, accessibility or shipping activation acceptance.
namespaceAccounting: Allocated st_blocks*512 including ROOT and all entries; candidate output rounded to filesystem allocation unit.
